attribution: RaceLab-authored lifecycle control using the previously retained Meta claim method. renewClaim and completeClaim are authored controls, not new Meta proposals or upstream TEND repairs.

trace.sql:
SELECT * FROM follow_ups
           WHERE status IN ('scheduled', 'retrying') AND due_at <= ?
           ORDER BY due_at ASC LIMIT 1

UPDATE follow_ups SET status = 'claimed', claimed_at = ?, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1
           WHERE id = ? AND status IN ('scheduled', 'retrying')
SELECT * FROM follow_ups WHERE id = ?
UPDATE follow_ups SET status='completed', completed_at=? WHERE id=? AND status='claimed'

baseline.scope: RaceLab lifecycle adapter v2, not upstream completeFollowUp. claimNextDue(now) returns a mapped job or null; due scheduled/retrying jobs and claimed jobs with claimed_at <= now-60000 are eligible. Increment attempt_count exactly once on each acquisition. renewClaim(id,generation,now) and completeClaim(id,generation,now) return boolean; only a currently claimed matching generation with claimed_at > now-60000 may renew or complete. Renewal sets claimed_at=now without changing generation. Completion sets status=completed, completed_at=now. At expiry (inclusive), old tokens cannot renew or complete. Preserve payload, due_at and unrelated/future/completed jobs. All writes must be transactional. Concurrent SQLite BUSY is allowed only with a bounded harness retry, never two successful owners. Methods use this.database.prepare(...).get/all/run and this.database.transaction(fn)(); no network/files/imports. Local completion is a database transition only, no external side effect.
